A nice idea I had in mind for a while.

What if the Monster Girls from cult classic Echidna Wars DX (2016), a vore-themed action game with excellent pixel art, were actually peaceful and civilized Monster Girl acteresses that auditioned for reference-video footage to be used to create the in-game pixel art sprites - meaning that their voracious and erotical digital counterparts are twisted reinterpretations?

Featuring the following Monster Girls:

Arachne (Spider Woman)
Cybele (Succubus type)
Lamia Mage (Snake Woman)
Queen Bee (Not the bees, ARHHHHH)
Water Slime Girl (Undine type)

Each girl gets a pinup artwork at the end of the comic too as a bonus!
